request:
Create one finished full-body illustration of the exact canonical Legacy male character from Image 2, using Image 1 only for body pose, framing and plain white studio staging.

Reference authority: Image 1 is the supplied human pose. Borrow only its raised-arm joint arrangement, closed-fist gesture, wide bent-knee stance and portrait composition. Do not inherit the human face, expression, skin, hair, slender proportions, checked overshirt, white undershirt, blue jeans or brown shoes. Image 2 alone controls character identity, facial construction, anatomy, proportions, outfit and illustrated rendering. Its multiple views depict ONE character; draw him once.

Retain the male master's broad muscular adult build, shoulder-to-waist relationship, golden lion fur, distinctive layered golden mane, ears, amber eyes and strong brows, cream muzzle/chin, black nose, confident closed-mouth expression, tail with golden tuft, fitted black short-sleeve polo, black trousers, belt and black lace-up footwear. Match the master's commercial mascot illustration, confident contour work, sculpted controlled shading and warm highlights. Keep recognizable identity through the changed pose; do not redesign him as a generic lion, a human wearing a lion mask, a photograph or a 3D figure.

Pose and frame: both arms lifted diagonally overhead in a broad victory V, elbows slightly bent, both hands closed into anatomically coherent fists. Legs spread, knees bent, feet planted and angled outward as in Image 1. Transfer these joint relationships onto the master's powerful proportions. Preserve the portrait 2:3 framing, generous white space above the fists and small white margin below the feet. Show the entire character, both fists, both shoes and tail without cropping; keep the tail naturally visible without competing with the gesture.

Hands retain the master's golden-furred, rounded knuckles and blunt natural fingertips/nails. On closed fists, show only nails that would naturally be visible. No invented dark nails, pointed claws, talons or extra digits. Use a clean white background and a subtle grounding shadow. No added props, people, typography, labels, logos, border or reference-sheet panels.
preserve: Canonical male identity, build, black outfit, illustration and blunt nails; target only pose/framing
Two raised closed fists, broad V arms, wide bent-knee stance and full-body white portrait frame
scope_boundary: One principal character; bounded, explicitly requested changes.
